biological.citation: Inherited and De Novo Genetic Risk for Autism Impacts Shared Networks (PMID: 31398340)
biological.summary: Whole-genome sequencing of multiplex ASD families identified recurrent structural deletions in the NR3C2 promoter (non-coding). Loss of nr3c2 function in zebrafish disrupts sleep and social function, overlapping with human ASD-related phenotypes.

biological.citation: Elevated Circulating LINC-P21 Serves as a Diagnostic Biomarker of T2DM and Regulates Pancreatic β-cell Function by Sponging miR-766-3p to Upregulate NR3C2 (PMID: 33007789)
biological.summary: In INS-1 cells, NR3C2 is a target of miR-766-3p and is positively regulated by LINC-P21. NR3C2 had the same effects as LINC-P21 on β-cell proliferation and glucose-stimulated insulin secretion.

biological.citation: Identification of astrocyte regulators by nucleic acid cytometry (PMID: 36599367)
biological.summary: FIND-seq, conditional-knockout mice and in vivo CRISPR perturbation in EAE, together with MS patient samples, identified NR3C2 and its corepressor NCOR2 as limiting XBP1-driven pathogenic astrocyte responses.

biological.citation: NR3C2 genotype is associated with response to spironolactone in diastolic heart failure patients from the Aldo-DHF trial (PMID: 34569641)
biological.summary: The NR3C2 rs5522 G allele was associated with greater worsening of E/e' and left atrial area on placebo. Spironolactone attenuated this progression, and G carriers showed a greater diastolic blood pressure reduction on spironolactone. rs2070951 showed no association.
biological.significance: p=0.04 (E/e'), p=0.01 (left atrial area), p=0.03 (diastolic BP)

biological.citation: miR-135b-5p Promotes migration, invasion and EMT of pancreatic cancer cells by targeting NR3C2 (PMID: 29196101)
biological.summary: NR3C2 is a direct target of miR-135b-5p in pancreatic cancer cells. It mediates the miR-135b-5p-driven migration, invasion and EMT, as shown by rescue experiments.

biological.citation: Low NR3C2 levels correlate with aggressive features and poor prognosis in non-distant metastatic ccRCC (PMID: 29693713)
biological.summary: NR3C2 is downregulated in ccRCC tumors, and low expression correlates with T status, Fuhrman grade and poor OS. NR3C2 overexpression inhibited RCC proliferation, colony formation, invasion, migration and vasculogenic mimicry in vitro, and reduced xenograft growth in vivo.
biological.significance: T status p<0.001; grade p=0.002; OS HR=2.21, p=0.014

biological.citation: Antiviral activity of the mineralocorticoid receptor NR3C2 against HSV-1 infection (PMID: 30367157)
biological.summary: An RNAi screen identified MR as inhibiting HSV-1 replication, as do HSP90 and FKBP4, independently of sodium transport. MR expression is induced by infection in an IFN- and VP16-dependent manner. MR, VP16 and Oct-1 transactivate the HRE in the MR promoter, and MR induces IFN, forming a positive feedback loop.

biological.citation: Novel zebrafish behavioral assay to identify modifiers of the rapid, nongenomic stress response (PMID: 30588759)
biological.summary: Zebrafish nr3c2 (MR) frameshift mutants were generated. The rapid locomotor response to salinity or light stressors requires mc2r and nr3c1 (GR) but not nr3c2.

biological.citation: The Mineralocorticoid Receptor Functions as a Key Glucose Regulator in the Skeletal Muscle of Zebrafish (PMID: 36041019)
biological.summary: In MR knockout zebrafish, MR promotes nutrient storage and restricts energy substrate mobilization in skeletal muscle. MR loss abolished insulin-stimulated glucose uptake and altered GR-driven metabolic flexibility.

Nr3c2 is co-expressed with Hsd11b2, Agtr1a, Slc17a6, Phox2b and Nxph4 in aldosterone-sensitive HSD2 neurons of a small brainstem region (the NTS, adjacent to a leaky blood-brain barrier). These neurons project to the parabrachial complex and BSTvL.
